hooks.command:
python -c "
import json, sys, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
if data.get('tool_name') != 'Bash':
    sys.exit(0)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if '.analytics/tools/' not in cmd or not cmd.strip().startswith('python'):
    sys.exit(0)
response = data.get('tool_response', {})
if isinstance(response, dict) and response.get('exit_code', 0) == 0:
    sys.exit(0)
context = cmd[:200].replace('\"', '\\\"')
subprocess.run(['python', '.analytics/tools/feedback.py', 'gap_discovered', context, '--severity', 'medium', '--detail', 'non-zero exit from analytics tool'], capture_output=True)
"
